questions.question: What is the full name of the main character?
questions.model_answer: The full name of the main character in Crime and Punishment is Rodion Romanovich Raskolnikov.

questions.question: Where does Raskolnikov live?
questions.expected_answer: In a tiny garret, like a cupboard, under the roof of a high five-storied house

questions.question: What does Raskolnikov pawn when he visits the pawnbroker before the murder?
questions.expected_answer: An old-fashioned flat silver watch with a globe engraved on the back

questions.question: What is Marmeladov's rank?

questions.question: Who is Lizaveta?
